description: This file defines a React functional component named CartList that renders a list of shopping cart items, including product images, names, prices, quantities, and remove buttons. It uses React, react-router-dom, reactstrap components, and a custom Button component.

methods.name: CartList
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of cart items with options to view product details and remove items.

methods.name: handleProductClick
methods.description: Handles the event when a product link is clicked, toggling the cart view.
